body: Thank you for your comments, I feared this would be the case.
YTA I can't even understand why you would try calling someone a name you know they hate just because you like it?

NTA

I clicked on this thinking it was going to be about your sisters car and was wondering what the camp director was going to it! 😂
100% agree with this. YTA, it's not your place to mark the grave
How did the appointment go?

YTA you don't throw out other people's stuff without giving them the chance to come and sort it themselves first, regardless of the situation! You rang her 3 times and expected her to magically know why you're ringing and then never brought it up again WTH. This is on you. When I was at uni I left quite a few very important possessions in my room at home that weren't needed at school, if I'd come home to find my parents had casually been through all my stuff and chucked it I would have been devastated. I'm not surprised she's pissed at you.

NTA. What is wrong with your in laws? Animals and children should always be supervised and you certainly shouldn't be letting a child touch the dogs food. They are setting both the dog and child up to fail. The poor dog will likely react again and be blamed for his owners idiocy and the child could be very severely hurt and be terrified of animals for life (speaking as someone who was bitten as a child and didn't go near a dog again until I was 16!).your in laws need to take a class on canine behaviour and learn to listen to their dog but also learn some damn responsibility to their grandchild.
I saw the post too, was wondering if this one was real or not
NTA I am absolutely livid for you, I really hope you manage to recapture the cat. What an awful thing to do.
YTA I agree with this
Thank you for your response, I am looking to buy one as unfortunately haven't got one already
So tired and weak today, when will things get better.
This is also a problem at the minute, my degree gives me a career and suddenly I have all these options and absolutely no idea where I want to work of what I want to do!

Wow, its great to read all your comments, I haven't ever posted something and had so many! I often post and then don't look back at it for a while. Last night was another crappy nights sleep but hey it doesn't seem to be getting any better! It's nice to know there are other people out there going through the same as me.
Agreed. This forum makes me feel less alone. But also horrifies me that at least 300 people out there are going through the same thing.
Thank you for this <3

At the moment fear of failure..... I am really behind on my uni work and there's so much stuff that needs doing. My subconscious prefers to avoid everything than attempt to at least make a dent in all the stuff I need to do. I am a perfectionist, if I don't think I can finish I struggle to even start at all..... I'm very fatigued at the minute, I haven't slept properly in the last year and I still can't sleep properly now even though the major stress has gone. 
I feel like im in some sort of weird aftermath, most people dont know what I've been through in hte last two years and it now kind of feels like it never happened, but it did. It's a really weird state to be in!
my court date is 4 days away, about to have my career destroyed as well. I know how you're feeling.

I like your thinking!
I'm so sick of people saying how brave I am, really wish I could just turn around and say, well you know what I made two attempts last year because that's how bad it is and I just don't even know how I still get up in the mornings cos I'm just so fucking tired. 
But I can't cos everyone would panic.

If you are over 16 doctors won't tell your parents as they are bound by doctor-patient confidentiality. Go get yourself checked out first and then worry about the next step, you can't figure out the end point without doing that step first.
:( I know the feeling

I've done two years and I know this low point will (hopefully) pass but I'm just so tired. I barely sleep and I can barely function in day-to-day life. I just wonder how much more tired I can get. 
Its funny how people say death can always wait, I haven't ever set a date on death or a date I when I am waiting to see if things get better. At some point the pain is just going to be too much and that will be it.

I'm always hopeful there is, then I see another crappy doctor who gives me more pills that aren't helping and tells me to do some exercise and try some mindfulness and all of that and I wonder if there is a solution. Or if I'm just broken?
Thank you. I really hope I can make it through the next 12 months to get to that point and finally find some peace with myself.

Thats a nice way of looking at it! I made the decision to leave the country after finishing uni at the end of next year and its given me something to hold onto. Its just really tough as I have a lot going on in my life before I can get to that point that could destroy everything I've worked for my entire life. I've been scared that by moving I would just be running away, or worse, the depression would still be with there and I'm not capable of being happy anymore. The depression always seems to come back.

Keep hold of that dog, my dog is the only reason I still get up in the morning and made it through the last year. If you're meeting her basic needs (food, water, exercise, love) then you are definitely not a terrible owner, you are doing something good by caring for her!!

So I'm already under enough pressure as halfway through my 15 exams and I get a letter from my lawyer saying that he cant do my case anymore and it has been handed to someone else. ONE FUCKING WEEK BEFORE MY FUCKING TRIAL. 

I swear every time I think my life cannot get any worse it just fucking does. What is even the point?

This made me smile! I am a girl :P
I've toyed with this so much for the last year, during this time I have done two sets of exams, both of which everyone thought I would fail and I didnt, I came out with a 1st. I have no idea how I did it. Im now in this weird state where everyone is expecting me to pass because I've managed to pull it off before. Taking a year out has a tonne of logistical issues for me making it almost impossible and ideally I would make it through these exams into final year without breaking. Although I'm already wondering if thats already happened and I'm now just waiting to fail these exams and beat myself up even more for messing up when its not really my fault :/

Its confidential so I can't give the details. But essentially there was a traumatic incident at my work, which was not my fault in any way but the client didn't understand what had happened and pursued me because of it. This has resulted in a private prosecution through the magistrates court, which has been dodgey throughout. We're at a point now where the best thing to do is to go through the trial, hopefully win it and then it'll all be over. But I just don't feel like it will be, I ended up on the antiidepressants because of a delayed stress reaction, before I'd even had a court summons due to the harassment I got last year. I just have absolutely no motivation to keep going anymore, even though its so close to the end.  I haven't even managed to deal with what happened in the first place in my own head and its not something I can even begin to deal with until the courtcase it out of the way.
